There are the following directories: /src contains a minimal implementation of AlphaEvolve with local evaluation. /omega contains code and data related to the new upper bound on the matrix multiplication exponent discovered by AlphaEvolve. It includes a Colab notebook for rigorous verification using rational arithmetic, and a level_3/ subdirectory with the gradient-based optimisation code at recursion depth 3: level_3/final_program.py — the optimisation program evolved by AlphaEvolve. It builds a differentiable upper-bound model in JAX/Haiku, runs gradient descent over 32k steps with 32 random seeds, and converts the best solution into a format suitable for verification. Run it directly with python3 final_program.py . level_3/verification.py — a NumPy/SciPy verifier that takes a flat parameter vector produced by the optimiser and evaluates the proven omega upper bound. It uses floating-point arithmetic for fast hill-climbing; the companion Colab notebook uses rational arithmetic for a rigorous proof. A requirements.txt listing the pinned Python dependencies and a Dockerfile for containerised execution are also provided in level_3/ . /maths contains the initial programs, discovered results, and verification code for the mathematical problems on which AlphaEvolve found a solution outperforming the state-of-the-art (see the "Results" section of the paper). There is a subfolder for each of such problems, each containing the files needed to run an AlphaEvolve experiment and a Colab notebook to verify the found construction. /matmul_tensor_decompositions contains Colab notebooks with the decompositions of matrix multiplication tensors across the matrix sizes for which the gradient-based optimization method from AlphaEvolve found a solution outperforming the state-of-the-art, along with the code to verify their correctness. Specifically, there are two Colabs: one for the standard tensor rank decomposition, and another one for the support rank. For the folders /maths and /matmul_tensor_decompositions , no installation is required. The provided notebooks can be opened and run in Google Colab. For the folder /src , these are the installation instructions: Install docker (required for program evaluation): https://www.docker.com/get-started/ (optional) Create venv: sudo apt-get install virtualenv python3-venv virtualenv -p python3.11 alpha_evolve source alpha_evolve/bin/activate Install pip dependencies: pip install -r src/requirements.txt Set Gemini API key : export GEMINI_API_KEY= < your_api_key > Usage /omega : The Colab notebook to verify the new upper bound on the matrix multiplication exponent can be opened via: .
